name: cover-me-video
description: The 30 s Chrome Web Store and YouTube video, rendered from code. See README.md.

scripts.audio: node score.mjs out/music.wav && node cues.mjs && node sfx.mjs cues.json out/sfx.wav
scripts.draft: node render.mjs --format 16x9 --workers 6 && node mix.mjs out/16x9/silent.mp4 out/16x9/draft.mp4
scripts.final: node render.mjs --format 16x9 --fps 60 --sub 4 --workers 6 && node mix.mjs out/16x9/silent.mp4 out/16x9/final.mp4
